lines.speaker: Blond Man
lines.text: But can you tell me, Señor Laruja, what kind of man our host is?

lines.speaker: Blond Man
lines.text: I haven’t been introduced to him yet.

lines.speaker: Señor Laruja
lines.text: They say that he has gone out.

lines.speaker: Señor Laruja
lines.text: I haven’t seen him either.

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: There’s no need of introductions here.

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: Santiago is made of the right stuff.

lines.speaker: Señor Laruja
lines.text: No, he’s not the man who invented gunpowder.

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: You too, Señor Laruja.

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: How could the poor man invent gunpowder if, as is said, the Chinese invented it centuries ago?

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: The Chinese! Are you crazy?

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: Out with you!

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: A Franciscan, one of my Order, Fray What-do-you-call-him Savalls, invented it in the—ah the seventh century!

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: A Franciscan?

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: Well, he must have been a missionary in China, that Padre Savalls.

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: Schwartz, perhaps you mean, señora.

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: I don’t know. Fray Damaso said a Franciscan and I was only repeating.

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: Well, Savalls or Chevas, what does it matter?

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: The difference of a letter doesn’t make him a Chinaman.

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: And in the fourteenth century, not the seventh.

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: Well, neither does a century more or less make him a Dominican.

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: Don’t get angry, your Reverence.

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: So much the better that he did invent it so as to save his brethren the trouble.

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: And did you say, Padre Sibyla, that it was in the fourteenth century?

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: Was that before or after Christ?
